identities.semanticTaxonomySnapshotMeaning: Provenance identifier for the bounded set of official SEC source documents and endpoints listed in sourceAuthorities, as retrieved on 2026-09-19. It identifies which official reference set was consulted. It is NOT a claim that the SEC form vocabulary was enumerated, sampled exhaustively, or closed.

correctionProvenance.trigger: Independent verification IV1 returned FAIL local to the reference-data instance (0 BLOCKING, 2 MAJOR, 3 MINOR, 1 ADVISORY). The controlling methodology was not implicated, was not modified, and remains byte-identical.
changesApplied: F-1 / F-2 (MAJOR): removed the four registered entries 20-F, 20-F/A, 40-F and 40-F/A. The same exact SEC raw form values are officially polysemous: 20-F may be used as a Section 12 registration statement, an annual report or a transition report, and 40-F may be used as a Section 12 registration statement or an annual report. The registration-statement use does not satisfy RC3 "Annual periodic records". The exact raw form value alone therefore cannot deterministically establish RC3 for every instance, so blanket registration was unsafe. No replacement mapping, no MULTI disposition, no OUT_OF_BOUND row, no conditional rule and no heuristic was substituted. These four values now behave exactly like any other unregistered value: UNMAPPED / UNRESOLVED, PARTIAL coverage, no record class, no OUT_OF_BOUND, no absence claim.

F-3 (MINOR): corrected the SEC-FULLINDEX-2026-QTR2 provenance annotation from "342 distinct exact form-type strings" to "340 distinct exact form-type strings". Provenance metadata only. The source identity, URL, edition, retrieval date, SHA-256 and the 353,245 indexed filing rows figure are unchanged, and nothing is inferred from the count.

F-4 (MINOR): corrected basisType on the entries that claimed OFFICIAL_SEC_SUBMISSION_TYPE_DEFINITION_PLUS_STRUCTURED_FIELD_CARRIAGE_OBSERVATION without attaching structured-field carriage evidence. Seven entries carried that over-claim in v1.0 (10-K, 10-Q, 11-K, 20-F, 40-F, F-4, S-4); two of them (20-F, 40-F) are removed by F-1 / F-2, so five were relabelled to the existing, smaller and truthful basisType OFFICIAL_SEC_SUBMISSION_TYPE_DEFINITION. No carriage evidence was fabricated and no new SEC research was performed. Only 8-K and 8-K/A attach STRUCTURED_FIELD_CARRIAGE evidence, and only they retain the carriage basisType. The affected entries keep their OFFICIAL_FORM_DOCUMENT_CORROBORATION evidence, which remains explicitly recorded under its own evidenceRole in sourceEvidence.

Mechanical identity update: artifact, version and status now identify v1.0 CORR1; recordClassMappingVersion and rawFormValueResolutionVersion carry distinct CORR1 identities because exact raw-value resolution behaviour changed for four values.
changesNotApplied: No entry was added. The registry was not expanded and positive recall was not improved.
No mapping semantics were re-adjudicated for the 32 retained entries.
No methodology text, RC definition, proposition, unknown-handling rule, claim ceiling or closure rule was modified, reinterpreted or relied on differently.
No fresh SEC taxonomy search, form enumeration or vocabulary expansion was performed.

No record-level disambiguation, document parsing, cover-page reading, report-period inspection or transition-flag interpretation was introduced to rescue 20-F or 40-F. Any such disambiguation requires a separate authorized act.
semanticTaxonomySnapshotId is unchanged: the bounded official source reference set is unchanged, no source snapshot was added or removed, and only adjudication and metadata changed.

The SEC-FORM-20-F and SEC-FORM-40-F source authorities are retained although no entry now cites them. sourceAuthorities records the bounded set of official SEC documents actually consulted during authoring, which remains historically true, and retaining them keeps semanticTaxonomySnapshotId valid.

declaredLimitations: This instance is NON-EXHAUSTIVE and cannot be made exhaustive. It observes an open, externally controlled, evolving vocabulary.

Any raw form value not registered here resolves to UNMAPPED / UNRESOLVED and degrades collection coverage to PARTIAL. It never becomes OUT_OF_BOUND, never becomes a record class, and never supports an absence claim.

This instance registers ZERO OUT_OF_BOUND entries. No form has been positively adjudicated as incapable of satisfying all five RC definitions. Nothing here may be read as establishing that any form is outside RC1-RC5.

Incomplete positive recall is a deliberate, disclosed cost. A record that exists in source reality and satisfies an RC definition may resolve to UNMAPPED here, leaving that class NOT_ESTABLISHED with PARTIAL coverage. That is a recall limit, not an absence finding and not a methodology defect.

Bounded candidate universe. Candidates were limited to forms in the historical v0.1-CORR3 mapping lineage, raw values surfaced by IV2-IV4 as mapping or boundary problems, and raw values observed in the official current SEC filing flow. The SEC vocabulary was deliberately NOT enumerated.

Candidates investigated and deliberately left unregistered include SD, F-6, F-3ASR, 424B7, D, S-1, S-1/A, POS AM, the Regulation 14C information-statement family, and the Schedule TO / tender-offer family (SC TO-T, SC TO-I, SC TO-C, SC 14D9, SC 13E3). Each defaults to UNMAPPED / UNRESOLVED. None is adjudicated as OUT_OF_BOUND.

20-F, 20-F/A, 40-F and 40-F/A were registered as RC3 in v1.0 and were REMOVED in CORR1 as unsafe. Each of those exact raw form values is officially polysemous — the same value covers a Section 12 registration-statement use as well as an annual-report use — so the raw value alone cannot deterministically establish RC3 "Annual periodic records" for every instance. They now resolve to UNMAPPED / UNRESOLVED and degrade coverage to PARTIAL. They are NOT adjudicated as OUT_OF_BOUND, and their removal asserts nothing about whether any particular filing is an annual periodic record. This is a deliberate, disclosed recall cost taken in preference to an unsafe blanket mapping.

POS AM specifically is polysemous in official SEC documentation: the SEC Index to Forms lists it as the post-effective amendment submission type for multiple base registration statements, including both business-combination forms (S-4, F-4) and non-business-combination forms (S-1, S-3, F-6, S-11, S-B). The raw value alone does not determine the base registration statement, so official evidence yields incompatible candidate dispositions and no entry was registered.

One source authority, the EDGAR Filer Manual (Volume II) Index to Forms, carries an internal edition date of December 2020 although it was retrieved live from the official SEC URL on 2026-09-19. Submission types introduced after that edition are not described by it. Staleness is visible only through UNMAPPED to PARTIAL, never silently.
No entry carries a numeric, percentage or probabilistic confidence score. confidencePosture is a categorical statement about the derivation, not a measurement.

This instance claims no completeness of the SEC form vocabulary, no record-class closure, no record absence and no source exhaustiveness. No quantity of mappings or dispositions could establish any of them.
This instance is a CANDIDATE. It has not been independently verified, has not been accepted by the Owner, and authorises no implementation, no production use and no Git closure.
